scope: UIL girls' softball statewide dates and referral rules only. No individual team schedule, coach appointment, field, eligibility determination, invitation to recruit or university scholarship is asserted.

source.title: UIL Constitution and Contest Rules Subchapter M eligibility
UIL 2026-27 amendments effective August 1, 2026 unless noted

seasonSpecificExplanations.text: UIL's 2026-27 softball calendar lists January 30 as first interschool scrimmage date and includes both weekly scrimmage guidance and an unlimited-pre-first-interschool-game note. Quote or refer to the official current Section 1280 interpretation for particular school situations instead of oversimplifying the wording.
UIL cautions that STAAR testing can affect softball playoff game dates; listed certification and postseason deadlines are not a school-by-school fixture calendar.

Varsity eligibility depends on current UIL rules governing school attendance/enrollment, age, residence/attendance zone, transfers, amateur status and exceptions. Do not decide an individual student's eligibility based solely on a team's school page.

UIL Section 409 prohibits recruiting for athletics at all grade levels. A TexasDefined team guide provides the official school athletics contact path and UIL rules, but must never imply a third-party site can offer recruitment or guarantee an athletic scholarship.

UIL's published 2026–27 amendments include changed varsity-level eligibility for foreign exchange students; link the current rule and individual waiver/counselor resources instead of applying a blanket self-determination or reusing older rules.

editorialRestrictions: This document may be reused as a primary-source background reference, but each school page still needs its own 38-topic original research and full-page verification.
District/conference alignments are 2026–27 softball-specific; no football district reuse and no assumed state title playoff Division I/II match.
Never transform statewide season dates into a particular school's actual game schedule or assert 2027 rosters already published.
Verify UIL pages again before the first scheduled event and on each source review; if the source changes, use dated correction notes instead of silently publishing outdated dates.
